notes: Default layout drops the 66.28 GB of stock FL2VA transformer shards because PinkCherry replaces the DiT wholesale. Set INCLUDE_STOCK_TRANSFORMER=1 for the stock-vs-PinkCherry A/B; that needs about 211.72 GB and a 220 GB volume.
MiniMax H3 emits H.264 video plus 32 kHz stereo AAC in one pass, so this lane has no separate audio model and no mux step.
The 10Eros Max lane swaps the PinkCherry DiT for the restored 10Eros Max beta4 (66.3 GB, same footprint) and skips the turbo LoRA; the 220 GB container disk covers either.

artifacts.note: Self-contained FL2VA partition: Qwen3-VL text encoder (66.73 GB), video VAE (10.42 GB), audio VAE, tokenizer, processor, transformer config and weight index. FL2VA serves t2va as well as first/last-frame conditioning. Hugging Face verifies individual Hub/Xet objects.
Stock BF16 DiT, 13 shards. Only downloaded with INCLUDE_STOCK_TRANSFORMER=1 for the quality A/B against PinkCherry.

Full fine-tuned DiT, not an adapter. Verified by safetensors header: 535 tensors whose names and shapes match the stock FL2VA transformer (blocks.N.attn.qkv_proj.weight [21504, 5376], blocks.N.adaln_proj.linear.weight [96768, 2688], audio_patch_proj.weight [5376, 32]) with an embedded config matching the MiniMax H3 transformer. Loaded through SGLang's single-file transformer_weights_path override. The int8_convrot exports in the same repo are ComfyUI-quantized (comfy_quant U8 tensors, pruned AdaLN plus adaln_t_table) and are not loadable here.

8-step distillation LoRA, Apache-2.0. Plain export carrying key_format=minimax-h3-diffusers and alpha=8 in safetensors metadata, which is the form the SGLang cookbook loads. Wan's 4-step output was judged below the quality bar, so 8-step is the default here.
Aggressive 4-step profile. Only downloaded with INCLUDE_FAST_TURBO_LORA=1.

Two LFS halves of 33,138,856,624 bytes each (sum 66,277,713,248). 10Eros Max lane only (H3_NSFW_MODEL_ID=Andrew3453/10Eros-Max-h3-restored). TenStrip/10Eros-Max beta4 (TURBO-hybrid merge, curve-form pruned AdaLN) restored offline by restore_pruned_adaln.py: full_W = pruned_W @ adaln_basis, full_bias = pruned_bias - full_W @ adaln_mean for all 51 adaln_proj groups, time_embedder.* from the stock FL2VA shard 1, QKV rows already regrouped per head. Stored as two byte-range halves (classic LFS caps a file at 50 GB; xet failed the single 66 GB upload repeatedly) that download_models.py appends back into one file. 535 tensors with the stock names and shapes; loads through transformer_weights_path like PinkCherry. Distillation is in the weights: the lane runs with H3_TURBO_LORA_ENABLED=0 and 8 steps, so the turbo LoRA is not downloaded for it.
